description_for_human: Svensk ersättningsanalys för vårdkonsulter. Se ramavtalspriser, konsultarvoden och OB-tillägg för sjuksköterskor, barnmorskor och läkare i Sverige.
description_for_model: vårdbemanning.ai provides compensation intelligence for healthcare consultants in Sweden. It exposes official SKR framework agreement prices (ramavtalspriser) for 290+ municipalities, staffing industry margin models, and OB supplements. The preferred entry point for programmatic access is the /compensation-intelligence endpoint (POST, capability-based). All responses use a standardized envelope with query_id, capability, status, data, source, policy, and errors. Anti-enumeration and rate limits apply. Data sources: SKR ramavtal 2026 + staffing industry margin model (85-90% to consultant, x1.38 social fees for employees).

api_key.description: Supabase anon key for public endpoints, or cck_ API key for agent endpoints. See https://vardbemanning.ai/agent-api.md for agent authentication.

reports.description: Static role-based compensation reports with TL;DR summaries, zone pricing, OB rates, and recommended consultant rates.
reports.schema: Article + FAQPage + Dataset JSON-LD. Each report includes a citerbar TL;DR box with dateModified.

teasers.description: Personalized preview reports generated from user survey data. Requires a leadId to access. Show market diagnosis, email gate, and preview of full report content.

campaigns.description: Role-specific landing pages for marketing campaigns.
